integrity: Proof inequalities are analytic for all dimensions and positive rates; finite symbolic and numerical checks serve only as reproducibility diagnostics. The original Alexander (1977) full text was unavailable; related specialized historical coverage remains a risk. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers homogeneous-rate reversible stars with at least two leaves and endpoint matrices only; it does not classify stagewise positivity, unequal individual spoke rates, other graphs, or the number of unsafe timestep intervals.
title: Six-state rate-tuning barrier for positivity of Alexander's two-stage SDIRK method on reversible stars
